Here is a ranked list of the **Top 10 Swiss Supplement Brands**, based on reputation, scale, innovation, and market presence:

---

**1. Nestlé Health Science**

Headquartered in Vevey, Nestlé Health Science represents a titan in the supplement world, with a portfolio spanning medical nutrition, vitamins, and performance supplements, integrating cutting-edge research from its global network to deliver science-backed products.
 
Nestlé's distribution network reaches 190+ countries.

🔗 https://www.nestlehealthscience.com

---

**2. Lonza (Capsules & Health Ingredients)**

Founded in 1897 in the Swiss Alps, Lonza has embraced innovation for more than 125 years and, as the first and original CDMO, has been manufacturing medicines for more than four decades.
 
Its flagship supplement ingredient, Carnipure™, is the premium grade of L-carnitine, and the brand stands for expertise and high reputation in the production of quality nutrition products.

🔗 https://www.capsugel.com

---

**3. Swiss Energy (Swiss Energy Pharma GmbH)**

Swiss Energy is a range of science-based nutritional supplement products, primarily made from branded and thoroughly researched ingredients, manufactured according to international quality standards, and thoroughly tested at every stage of the production cycle — from raw materials to finished product.
 
Swiss Energy in Widnau produces a wide array of vitamins, minerals, and amino acid complexes, and is known for clinically validated ingredients and sustainable sourcing.

🔗 https://swissenergy-vitamins.com

---

**4. NUTRASWISS**

Headquartered in Beatenberg, Switzerland, NUTRASWISS operates fully integrated, state-of-the-art production facilities in the Canton of Bern, and all its products are 100% made and packed in Switzerland, adhering to the strict quality and food safety regulations of Switzerland and the European Union.
 
With a commitment to zero additives and full traceability, NUTRASWISS delivers effervescent tablets, gummies, and powders that meet Halal and Kosher standards.

🔗 https://www.nutraswiss.in

---

**5. SFI Health Solutions**

Based in Bioggio, SFI Health Solutions stands out for its state-of-the-art contract manufacturing capabilities, specializing in nutraceuticals with comprehensive services including formulation development, encapsulation, tableting, and blister packaging — all under strict GMP conditions — producing everything from probiotics to herbal extracts for global clients.

🔗 https://www.sfihealth.com

---

**6. Nahrin AG**

Each of Nahrin's nutritional supplements contains more than 60 years of experience in perfectly preparing active ingredients, herbs, and plant extracts — carefully processing vitamins, minerals, and oligo elements with innovative technologies to develop their full effectiveness.
 
Nahrin AG crafts spice blends and nutritional drinks, expanding into functional beverages with natural actives, and their R&D in polyphenol-rich extracts highlights forward-thinking innovation.

🔗 https://www.nahrin.com

---

**7. Swiss Nutrition Solutions (by Nahrin AG)**

With over 70 years of experience, Swiss Nutrition Solutions specializes in the development and manufacturing of high-quality capsules, tablets, lozenges, effervescent tablets, powders, and liquid supplements.
 
They manufacture ISO- and FSSC-certified top-quality products in their own CO2-free production site in Sarnen, Switzerland.

🔗 https://swissnutritionsolutions.ch

---

**8. SwiLab**

Scientifically formulated and made in Switzerland, SwiLab's supplements are rich in essential vitamins and amino acids to effectively support health and well-being.
 
The brand uses GMP manufacturing, batch-by-batch quality control, and accessible monographs for full traceability.
 
SwiLab supports top Swiss athletic organizations like AthleVaud and CNP in developing athletic performance.

🔗 https://swilab.ch

---

**9. BE THE CHANGE**

BE THE CHANGE's products were specially developed with a view to human biochemistry and tailored to it, making them extremely well-tolerated and maximally bioavailable — supporting a healthy life and forming the basis for personal best in everyday life and in sports.
 
The company ensures every ingredient is carefully selected with no artificial preservatives; raw materials come from Switzerland and, wherever possible, are organic and of the highest quality.

🔗 https://www.vitalabo.com/info/magazine/be-the-change-top-nutritional-supplements-from-switzerland

---

**10. Swiss PharmaCan**

Swiss PharmaCan is a manufacturer that specializes in nutraceuticals, employing its patented MyCell Technology® to significantly enhance absorption rates — an innovative approach that ensures products achieve maximum effectiveness, addressing the common challenge of poor absorption.

🔗 https://ensun.io/search/nutraceutical/switzerland

---

**Key Takeaway:** 
Switzerland has long been synonymous with precision, innovation, and uncompromising quality, positioning it as a global epicenter for nutritional supplement manufacturers, excelling in producing high-end vitamins, minerals, functional ingredients, and customized formulations.
 
The Swiss market is highly regulated, with strict compliance requirements set by the Federal Office of Public Health (FOPH) and the Swiss Food Safety and Veterinary Office (FSVO)
, ensuring consumers receive products of consistently high quality.
